intro: Professionals and everyday users convert ounces (oz) to grams (g) when working across imperial and metric standards in engineering specifications, international trade documentation, and technical measurements. One ounce equals 28.349523 grams, while 1 gram equals 0.035274 ounces. Whether you are verifying mass & weight specifications on imported equipment, cross-checking technical datasheets, or scaling practical measurements, this converter applies the exact NIST SP 811 and ISO 80000 reference relationship with instant precision.

mistakesAndEdgeCases.title: Avoirdupois Ounces (oz) vs. Precious Metal Troy Ounces (oz t) vs. Fluid Ounces (fl oz)
items: Standard grocery and postal scales use the Avoirdupois ounce (1 oz = 28.349523125 g). Gold, silver, and platinum bullion use the Troy ounce (1 oz t = 31.1034768 g), which is 9.7% heavier.
Never confuse dry weight ounces (oz) with liquid volume fluid ounces (fl oz); they only match numerically for pure water at standard density.

faqs.question: How many grams (g) are in 1 ounce (oz)?
faqs.answer: There are 28.34952313 grams (g) in 1 ounce (oz), which rounds to 28.3495 g for everyday calculations. Conversely, 1 gram equals 0.035274 ounces.

faqs.question: How do I convert ounces to grams (oz to g)?
faqs.answer: To convert ounces to grams, use the formula: g = oz × 28.34952313. For example, converting 6 oz gives 170.0971 g.

faqs.question: What is 6 ounces in grams?
faqs.answer: 6 ounces (oz) equals exactly 170.0971 grams (g) using standard NIST SP 811 and ISO 80000 conversion factors.
